strings.YGR_selfmade_men_desc: Our governmental apparatus stands unique amongst the ruins of Russia, in that it is staffed mostly by the... entrepreneurs of the Old Motherland. While this may lead to us being seen as a nation of Thieves-in-Law, our leaders' unique career paths may prove useful, not just for negotiation, but for trade as well. Our methods may be crude, but they yield results; and that is all that matters.
strings.YGR_zlatoust_made_government_desc: The fact still stands; without our Sister Republic in Zlatoust, we will be nothing more than a leaf in the wind. With their protection, however, we will be able to see to our... unique ventures without fearing foreign disturbances.
strings.YGR_siberian_democracy_desc: With the criminals in charge having been cast down, we have an unique opportunity to create a properly democratic system in these Siberian wastelands. An opportunity that our new leadership does not want to let slip.
strings.YGR_siberian_faithful_desc: The decadent earthly trappings of the Yugra have been cast down at last in favor of the Word of God. Now we have the opportunity to properly show our people the road to their salvation, and then extend this grace to Siberia, the Motherland and beyond.
strings.YGR_pechora_war_desc: The Pechora War is the latest squabble between the two northern states of Vorkuta and Yugra. However, this time, both parties intend to finish what they started.
strings.YGR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
In the tundras of Western Siberia, haggard travelers in pubs and taverns alike tell stories about the bandits of Arctic Russia, guided onwards by the Great Pakhan. They spread word of his escapades, from breaking out of the Vorkuta gulags in the far North to establishing a criminal community in the badlands of Yugra. The reason for everything is the collapse of the West Siberian People's Republic, and the escape of many prisoners from local prisons - Gulags. All these criminal authorities united around Ioseliani to organize their own criminal rule in the region. Their flag contains two symbols often associated by the Russian mafia - a star and a cat.

Despite initial success in achieving their goals, including victory in the battle for the Saranpaul mountain range, forces loyal to the Vorkuta Gulag administration still drove the criminal state (Operation Vory Exodus) from the Arctic coast around Vorkuta, leading to the choice of the city of Yugorsk as the capital.
strings.YGR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2:
The Thief Territory of Yugra was founded a few years ago, following the escape of the Vory V Zakone criminal gang from the Vorkuta Gulag in the north. Refusing to break the criminal code and cooperate with the guards following the collapse of the Soviet Union, a series of violent skirmishes occurred before. The gang now lead by Georgian mafioso Jaba Ioseliani, who escaped to found a criminal run territory out of Yugra.

After their escape the Vory v Zakone gang made their way east - to Yugorsk which became their main operational base, free from any kind of law enforcement. This lawless land ruled by criminal syndicates has proved to be a major hub for the black market. Zlatoust – the only neighbour Yugra cooperates and has good relations with. Ioseliani has recently established a protection agreement in exchange for weapons from Dragunov's arms empire, which was a big letdown for those who were part of the criminal hierarchy and considered it as a betrayal of the criminal code.
strings.YGR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3:
Despite their problematic organization, the thieves can rely on unorthodox tactics, allowing them to disrupt supply lines, sowing discord among the enemy ranks before finally moving in for the kill. However the state needs deep restructuring for the foreseeable future, and most importantly someone capable of reforming their armed forces. But the route to be king will be long and tedious.

All our neighbors are watching our foreign policy with concern. To the west of us lies the Vorkuta Gulag — a Russian hell, controlled by Blokhin and his NKVD from which our thieves and bandits have barely escaped. To the east are the Free Aviators, famous Night Witches, who rule the skies over western Russia and its western Siberian part. The old Red Guard from Sverdlovsk, the Stalinists from Tyumen, and the Black League from Omsk are fighting for supremacy over the southern region of Western Siberia, but they are not yet aware of a possible unexpected rival in the north...
strings.YGR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.4:
At the top of the food chain in this criminal paradise are Jaba Ioseliani and Aslan Usoyan, the Wolf and the Spider.

Little is known about the early years and youth of the Wolf, except for his eternal rejection and disobedience to the Soviet authorities, because of which he, as well as other members of the banned organization Vory v Zakone, had been imprisoned in the Vorkuta gulags for many years.

Until finally, following the collapse of soviet power, an escape was organized after a series of violent clashes and riots, during which Ioseliani led a rebellion that played a decisive role in the release of various prisoners and the establishment of his undisputed leadership. With their liberation, Jaba Ioseliani would eventually found The Thief Territory of Yugra; an almost anarchic, bandit state ran by criminals and Mafia.
strings.YGR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.5:
Behind the scenes, Spider Aslan Usoyan secretly continues to weave intrigues and search for compromising information against Wolf.

Spider plays his role, pretending to be a reliable member of the criminal organization. However, in reality, Aslan Usoyan dreams of transforming this anarchic Territory of Thieves into a huge corporation that will directly control the flow of most goods sold in the new Russia, offering cheap labor and loose regulations.

Usoyan calls for the introduction of a program of direct state control of prices and rationing so that everyone can eat their fill and work hard for the benefit of the newly formed capitalist class. However, the wolf is a sworn enemy of capitalism and corporatism, relying more on profiteering through raids or backroom deals. Sooner or later, this internal organizational conflict will resume with renewed vigor.
strings.YGR_the_land_of_crime_desc:
The feat of the bandits of Yugra is a known one in Russia. 

Two years ago we escaped from the gulags of Vorkuta, the prison state, and with Jaba Ioseliani as our guide estabilished ourselves in Yugorsk, mere miles south. An organized criminal community was born, the gangs divided the already poor territory and sustained themselves with the sparings of the local populance. Now winds of change are blowing in Russia, the conflict between the Old Guard, the Stalinists and the League is rekindling and we must prepare ourselves if we wish to overcome the challenges that fate brings us.
strings.YGR_ioselianis_ambition_desc: Despite the different morals of each gang, the Great Pakhan Jaba Ioseliani managed to maintain some resemblance of order in the territory, he is seen as a guiding light by the bandits of Yugra. Despite his popularity with the common thieves, the Pakhans are becoming agitated for his lack of action, mostly due of his compliance and the trade deals with Zlatoust, seen as an infringement of the Vory code. In time these troubling rumours risk to topple Ioseliani from his position of power, he needs to take action as soon as possible.
strings.YGR_ioselianis_ambition_ct: Ioseliani's lack of action must be adressed as soon as possible
strings.YGR_convene_the_shadow_council_cs: The dice is cast, time has come to summmon the Circle
strings.YGR_convene_the_shadow_council_desc: The Circle is the closest thing the Thief Territory has to a governance structure, the meeting of the territory's pakhans, and if the changes required to quell the region's madmen are to be made, they are to be made through this meeting. Everyone has their own interests, but no one is foolish enough to choose something that shall make our united position worse off if they don't wish to have the rest of the pakhan's on them. The Circle is convened!
strings.YGR_industrial_buildup_desc: Yugra, unfortunately, did not reap much benefits of the previous Union. It is not West enough to be part of the European industrial breadbasket (and yet West enough to be on the receiving end of the Terror Bombings), not South enough to have cities developed in it, not East enough to benefit from Bukharin's industrial plan, and not North enough to have industrial gulags built in it. All in all, we are Russia's middle child, and we will have to claw our way out of this on our own.
strings.YGR_review_the_criminal_code_desc: The Criminal Code, the laws of Thieves, is made up of several important outlines on how the pakhan's must act in their own fiefdoms: the Bond being the outline of the share of responsibilities and privileges pakhan's hold in the hierarchy, the Lace being the protection money and other forms of tax taken from the general populace, and of course, the Circle's public status, for now neither legally private nor public. If we are to expand we need to hammer out any of the loopholes and discrepancies in the code.
strings.YGR_maintain_the_thieves_responsibilitie: The Bond's pakhan structure has served us well, the strong and decentralized duchy-like organisation allowing us to hold more land than it would originally be possible. To sacrifice this part of the Code would be shooting our own brothers in the back and ourselves in the foot. The privileges of the Thieves stays, if not for their loyalty then our own stability.
strings.YGR_reform_the_thieves_bond_desc: This isn't the 16th century, and we aren't feudal lords, yet for some reason the Bond seems to replicate that outdated structure marvelously. Our state is inefficient, federal decisions  are held back by the squabbling of the minor pakhans, our lands overextended, our grasp weak. If we wish to continue expanding, the state must be centralised as to not collapse under the weight of all the differing interests of… “strong personalities” that rule our regions.
strings.YGR_make_them_pay_the_lace_desc: The Lace is an inalienable right of the pakhans to the civilians of the lands they hold responsibility for. Voiding these rights would mean that the pakhans would have less resources to arm themselves and their men and, even worse, less reasons to stay loyal to us. The Lace stays, we are not in the right to destroy it.
strings.YGR_spare_their_savings_desc: If we wish to erase the image of “state-enforced extortion” from our people's minds, the best place to start is to remove the Lace. Another feudal-like institution, it grants the regional pakhans much greater powers, let alone privileges, which they tend to abuse with irritating ease. A central taxation code and a stronger leash are in order.
strings.YGR_time_for_formalization_desc: There are many things that sparked the French Revolution, one of them being a perceived distance of the Versailles Palace from the slums of Paris, which allowed the King to make his decisions in his own bubble, ignorant of the woes of the people. While the Circle isn't as ignorant, it is best to avoid the people misinterpreting us and starting a revolt. The Circle must be opened for viewing, not for any form of democratization but for the simple need for legitimacy.
strings.YGR_time_for_formalization_ct: Formalizing the Circle will render diplomatic relations more easy in the near future
strings.YGR_maintain_the_councils_secrecy_desc: The Circle has always been a meeting for the pakhans, and there is very little reason to change that. Civvies are best kept in the dark, what they don't know won't hurt them and the little they do know is rumours. Our decisions are ours to make, and we don't need any more prying eyes than we already have.
strings.YGR_the_finishing_touches_desc: After hours of arguing, screaming and stand-offs, the reviewed Thieves' law is ready for its application, all that is left is to begin spreading and enforcing it. The territories will receive copies, the militia officers informed.
strings.YGR_renovate_the_yugorsk_arms_factory_de: While our territory cannot boast the industrial wonders of Zlatoust and the trade benefits it grants them, we are not completely bare. The Yugorsk Arms factory, while smaller than the Zlatoust one, still produces a steady supply of weapons and still has room for improvement and expansion. Shifting our resources to renovate the crumbling but functional production facility could turn out to be a prudent investment.
strings.YGR_expand_the_civilian_sector_desc: We lack the industrial power of the southern Communists, both in organized labour and industrial experience, leaving our population out of almost every basic necessity. While it certainly IS pleasant to live by armed robbery, if we wish to hold onto our rule, it is time that we begin improving the lives of our citizens.
strings.YGR_repurpose_the_gulags_desc: Ah, the GULAG, a Communist's wet dream. No food, shared responsibility, backbreaking labour, what else does a shriveled abomination need out of other people? Jokes aside, the gulags, while morbid, still have their own uses. Many have been built around natural resources, or were granted their own workshops, some still have the capability to hold prisoners without getting them killed. The gulag system will be repurposed for our needs, whatever they are.
strings.YGR_adjust_the_supply_lines_desc: Our supply lines are riddled with inefficiencies, the local armies and militias commonly relying on emergency support from locals or businessmen like Usoyan to win their skirmishes. While such desperate measures aren't uncommon, what does it say about the state of our armed forces? If our supply lines can't handle a small battle, how will they handle an all-out war? Our infrastructure and supply will be rethought, roads will be rebuilt, production boosted. Time to get out of the “Avos' will carry us” mindset.
strings.YGR_rehabilitate_the_saranpaul_airport_d: Up until recently, there was very little reason for us to pay the airport any mind. Our enemies rarely had any airpower and the Free Aviators already had ruled the skies for several decades. However, considering the new direction Yugra is heading in, getting a functioning air force is vital to our further victories and expansion, and something like a functioning runway tends to do wonders to the state of aviation.
strings.YGR_redraw_the_gangs_territories_desc: Yugra's political landscape is extremely fractured, the land and its people split between one too many pakhans. If we wish to become more effective in our rulership, they are to be merged. This will allow us to get rid of the less competent of our pakhans while rewarding the more loyal and effective, receiving greater loyalty and provincial development in return.
strings.YGR_conclude_the_council_desc: As conflicting as the last Circle meeting was, something new has appeared in the air, a sense of genuine change. Be the reforms for the better or for the worse, the pakhans are more ready for warfare than they ever were in the last decade, morale is once again high.
strings.YGR_conclude_the_council_ct: The meeting is concluded, everyone awaits Ioseliani to give his final speech
strings.YGR_ioselianis_final_speech_desc: The Great Pakhan takes the stage in the last minutes of the meeting. With the enthusiasm of the pakhans, the time is right for a sweeping speech!
strings.YGR_test_ural_district_desc: Our brigades are fully staffed, the military workshops are up and running, and every brother is eager for new loot. Enough time has passed since the end of the war with the Vorkuta guards, and the goods and valuables we plundered from them have run out. In the coming days, our generals will organize border skirmishes and raids against the Ural Military District. We will act at night to maximize the surprise effect of our attacks, to test their strength and preparedness, and to instill in them the fear of our bandits for the coming, inevitable war.
strings.YGR_may_the_subjugation_begin_desc: We may be bandits and thieves in the eyes of many, but there are many things we aren't. We aren't power hungry NKVD bastards holding the population in a prison camp, we aren't deranged Omskovite fanatics, we aren't the obscure remnants of a failed ideology, and we aren't nihilistic pseudo-capitalists slinging guns left and right. So for all intents and purposes, we may be bandits and thieves, but we are sure the last shard of sanity in this corner of Russia, and we aren't going down without a fight.
strings.YGR_all_the_weapons_a_man_could_desire: All The Weapons A Man Could Desire
strings.YGR_in_the_dark_alleys_of_omsk: In The Dark Alleys Of Omsk
strings.YGR_move_with_haste_desc: With the Germans bickering and fighting amongst themselves, the dreaded Luftwaffe has been cleared off our skies, to the delight of the people of Russia, but also of those above them. A new opportunity has struck. With no obstacles to their plans, the warlords are ambitiously planning to end the Smuta and take the Motherland for themselves. And that includes even us. We shall prepare our bands for the battles to come, and with tenacious hard work, all the riches of Russia shall be ours.
strings.YGR_arm_the_bandits_desc:
As the famed bandits of Russia, we pride ourselves in being able to work and steal freely from everyone and anyone. To that end, we use all available means affordable to us to rob and pillage for money, food, and the many natural resources left in our Motherland. However, times are changing. The warlords that surround us are many times stronger, and their soldiers fight not for riches but for their leaders' megalomaniacal goals of total conquest, masquerading in so-called ideals and ideologies that the masses would die for. If we want to become the greatest plunderers Russia has ever known, we will have to adapt to the times as well.

New weaponry, evolutionary successors to the AK-47, and even the best tanks, and aircraft this hellhole can provide, shall be the weapons of the future for the criminals of tomorrow to bask and relish in. With the Kalashnikovs on our side, we shall have the available resources to develop it all. And in the greatest of our desires, we hope that within a decade or so, all of Russia will be plundered of its great riches for our favor, and the spoils of war shall be divided evenly among the new soldierly of our bandit state.
strings.YGR_revising_our_strategies_desc: As we consolidate our hold over our lands and plan ahead for the unification of Russia under our rule, we have to be aware that we are currently just as weak as the other warlords are, and the way our “army” is run is not the best either.. Therefore, we will need new strategies to make sure we outmaneuver our enemies and defeat them in the dog-eat-dog competition that is the Second Time of Troubles. Our efficient and smart generals will do their finest and lead us into swift victory, and soon, all of Western Russia will be ours.
strings.YGR_sabotage_our_enemies_desc: War is tough, as we all may know, and our position currently is in a perilous state. Therefore, we must think out of our box and do some… cheating. Our operatives will sneak into the territory of our enemies and degrade their military capabilities to the point where we may actually stand a chance against them. And we can find those operators everywhere. After all, we were thieves who escaped the law, sneaking in should be our natural ability at this point.
strings.YGR_some_lucky_investments_desc: Despite how much we pride ourselves on the way we are, the reality is that, like every state that has ever existed, the Thief Territory of Yugra needs investors to run its economy and keep it afloat. The people with the most money have been the most influential in the history of humanity, as we can prove to ourselves, and we need them now more than ever to get this state off its footing and into the new world. Luckily, our mysterious nature to the rest of the outside world means that any desperate fool that decides to invest in this shithole will be convinced that we are just another patch of land for the grabbing instead of who we really are. At the end of the day, though, it shall greatly benefit us and our industry, getting us on edge with the rest of the warlord powers, but probably at the expanse of the investor. Probably.
strings.YGR_let_them_see_our_guns_desc:
With our military capabilities upgrading more and more, the call for bigger weaponry is getting, well… bigger as well! The enemy armies have entire truckloads of armor, tanks, artillery and fighter jets to overwhelm our forces with, so we will show them ours.

Massive guns shining on the horizon, their cannons ready to strike any unfortunate foul that dares to stand against us into oblivion. They will be our symbol for which all of Russia will fear us.
strings.YGR_the_great_pakhan_never_misses_desc:
Good old Jaba's plans were the saving grace that got us out of Vorkuta.

He believes that some cohesion can be found between the countless gangs of the thieves' territory, even if Usoyan's block disagrees with him. 'Give a man a good flogging, and he will treat you with at least a shred of respect', The Great Pakhan said, advocating for a stricter disciplinary code and harsher punishments. 'The blokes south of us have a well prepared army sitting on a treasure-sized pile of equipment. What can we do if our soldiers refuse to take a piss when asked? It will be a massacre!'

If the Great Pakhan's vision is realised, we could find ourselves with a formidable force that could challenge any gun-holding pig that hopes to resist us.
strings.YGR_uncle_hasans_magic_desc:
'Why work our asses off if uncle Hasan can find someone else to do the job?'

The thieves were wildly convinced by Usoyan's arguments at the latest circle meeting. The Kurdistani assured the Pakhans that he had the right contacts to help industrialise our territory, in exchange for lax business restrictions when we unify the region. 'The corporations can be our friends with the right trade. Who could stop us with the might of capitalism by our side?'. The Spider's words are honey to most ears, even more with the mention of money. With uncle Hasan's help, we will become richer than any bandit before us!
strings.YGR_improvised_but_effective_desc: As we set to expand, traditional warfare cannot be the only thing we rely on to do just that. We must discover new alternative methods of war to trick and destroy our enemies swiftly and effectively. Fortunately, our little idiots in the factories are in action building devices that will serve this purpose handily. Improvised bombs are the future, and we fuckers will go to those tanks and give them a one-way ticket to Hell!
strings.YGR_destroy_the_gulags_desc:
Long ago, the Gulags of the Soviet Union were horrible and treacherous traps, known as the place where thugs and ordinary citizens whose only crime were thinking the wrong way. The poor bastards were sent there to serve the rest of their lives in the so-called glory of the dictator Bukharin. Many of our comrades have ended up there, and they know just how hellish they were. 

Now we have captured the most notorious of them all. Vorkuta. The remnants of the communists there still ran this factory and its many prisoners to the ground, and we, as fellow criminals, will give them the justice they deserve. Every single Soviet officer will be shot and their corpses will be dug in by the rubble of the buildings and machines they helped create. And we shall give their victims the job of doing just that.
strings.YGR_the_aviators_shot_down_desc: Finally, we have penetrated the defenses of Surgut with ease, and the land of the Free Aviators, and the aviators themselves, are finally ours. We have to admit that these women were nothing less than heroes. Courageous, righteous and brave. They defended our land from the bloodthirsty Germans and their Luftwaffe, and we have to thank them for their service and everything they did. But this world is the opposite of righteous. It is cruel, and only the strongest can survive in it, and it shall be us, and us alone. We will get the Aviators to join our cause and use their aircraft for our far-reaching goals of conquest and riches.
strings.YGR_all_the_weapons_a_man_could_desire_d: When we first founded our territory so long ago, we were weak, pitiful, forced to rely on Kalashnikov and his merchants for protection. But now the tables have finally turned. Now we are the new masters of Zlatoust, our troops march in its neighborhoods and the factories where all of Russia's weaponry originates from, and we shall use them accordingly. The cogs in the machines shall work to their fullest and the heart of war in Russia shall produce its weaponry once more, but for us, and us only.
strings.YGR_parading_sverdlovsk_desc: Our boots now tread the streets of Svedlorsk, the capital of the former Soviet army situated here, and our recruits from them are plenty. Therefore, to commemorate our rise in this city of war, we shall do a military parade with the best and brightest our army has to offer, with all the newly captured equipment taken from Rokosovsky's useful idiots in full display.
strings.YGR_the_trial_of_the_stalinists_desc: With Tyumen in our hands, we should send the Stalinists and their fiercest supporters to where they belong. These people are the worst kind of scum. While we may be killers and thieves, we do it for the glory of wealth and the hunt, while they ignorantly strive for the brutal, immoral teachings of a long-dead man. They will be subjected evil by evil, a fate most deserving of them.
strings.YGR_in_the_dark_alleys_of_omsk_desc: Everyone has lost someone of their own to the Germans in the west. Mothers, fathers, sons and daughters, even we petty thieves know it deep in our hearts. Omsk is the culmination of that hatred. An entire people serving the higher-ups for the sole purpose of a genocidal goal against the entire Germanic race, and now we have entered the heart of it all. We shall take their precious resources and weapons they have prepared for the so-called Great Trial and we shall loot every last penny there, and dig the officers of the Black League their graves
strings.YGR_our_greatest_victory_desc:
We have finally done it!. All of Western Siberia, from Vorkuta to Omsk, is finally ours! This is a great day for us and our comrades who have served valiantly for their deserved riches and glory.

But there is still much to be done. Our region may be secure, but there is still the rest of the Motherland to conquer, much less Moscow and Petrograd. But no matter. We have fought to the death for our goals and we shall do it again, and soon the flag of the Thief Territory of Yugra shall be flown over the Kremlin itself. And all of the world will tremble before us!
strings.YGR_the_unlikely_victory_desc: After years of fighting, we've achieved what no other country on Earth thought possible; Yugran control over West Siberia. Vorkuta, Zlatoust, Sverdlovsk, Tyumen, and Omsk had been destroyed, subjugated, and integrated into the Thief Territory, and our small warlord state is now a fledgling world power. Let us celebrate! We must prepare a feast!
strings.YGR_the_victory_feast_desc: Meat, cheese, fresh vegetables, all the food of West Siberia is at our fingertips. All of this loot calls for one thing; a feast! We will get every gourmet morsel, every choice cut, every bit of good food left, and eat ALL OF IT. Prepare the tables! The chairs! All of it must be made ready for our feast of feasts. God bless the West Siberian Thief Territory! God bless Russia!
strings.YGR_unforseen_developments_desc: Of course, it seems that our pride preceded a fall. Another player, Aslan Usoyan, has shown his face. The Kurdish Spider has decided he would be a better leader than Ioseliani, and has shown his hand. As we speak, he has begun to make moves against our government and towards his own quest for power. Who should rule? The pakhan of pakhans? Or a new face; someone with his own vision for our future?
strings.YGR_unforseen_developments_ct: After our lucky victory, tensions between Ioseliani and Usoyan reach a new high and conflict is inevitable
strings.YGR_our_future_desc: Even with an active power struggle within our government, we still have a country to run. As the sole controller of a good part of Russia, we now have many, many mouths to feed, many new thieves, soldiers, and officials to placate, and the potential to forge a new, free Russia.
strings.YGR_our_duty_to_the_people_desc: The Thief Territory was founded as a state dedicated to the Vory v Zakone; the thieves-in-law. However, with our recent conquests, we find ourselves ruling over millions of people that aren't included in our way of life. As leaders of a new, proper nation, we must do something about our people. It's the least we can do, now that they give us so much money in taxes.
strings.YGR_our_duty_to_the_thieves_desc: The thieves-in-law are by far the most important people in our Territory. They are by far the most affected by our decisions, and we must work to aid them at all costs.
strings.YGR_our_duty_to_russia_desc: We're a real country now, so let's act like it! Operating simply as armed mobsters may have worked when all we had was Yugra, but now we've got thousands of miles under our feet. We need a defined structure for our government, for the sake of our people, our government, and for the world stage.
strings.YGR_aid_those_we_protect_desc: Under our... jackboot? Regular boot? Under some form of footwear, we have millions that need food, water, and shelter. These people have few rights, few opportunities, and fewer ways to get the things they need. As the government, we're in a position to help those people. The time to act is now!
strings.YGR_squeeze_them_dry_desc: Who do we rule? Bastards, that's who! Not even a year ago, all these people wanted to kill us, and now they want us to give them things, willy-nilly? What nonsense! Take their money and put it in our coffers! We'll see how much they want to complain after that.
strings.YGR_thieves_for_charity_desc: Just because we're thieves-in-law doesn't mean we have to steal from the people. West Siberia's people deserve better than the authoritarian kleptocrats that took everything from them in the cause of ridiculous ideals. Communism, militarism, and socialism all failed them, but our position as rulers gives us the opportunity to give back; after all, where's the fun in stealing from people who can't do anything back?
strings.YGR_your_loyalty_for_survival_desc: The rats we rule over are just that; rats. They're just as quick to praise you as they are to stab you in the back. If we want to rule these lands, we cannot show them silly things like “mercy”, “human rights”, or similar nonsense. If they want to live in West Siberia, in OUR land, they'll have to listen to us, and only us. The only thing they deserve is to live in exchange for their servitude.
strings.YGR_estabilish_our_legitimacy_desc: Whether by fear or charity, we must establish ourselves as the rightful rulers of Russia, now that there are people to rule other than ourselves. With the people on our side, we might actually be able to achieve great things; the formation of a people-focused Russia, a lasting global impression, and, greatest of all, a unified Russia.
strings.YGR_favour_ioselianis_loyalists_desc: Jaba Ioseliani has led us as long as we've needed a leader, and now the fat Kurd Usoyan wants to depose him? We cannot allow this treachery to who and what we are. It is time to fight for our great Pakhan! Let's get to work!
strings.YGR_favour_usoyans_cliche_desc: Aslan Usoyan is the man we need to save our new nation! He already effectively controls this nation; the useless, lethargic Jaba Ioseliani is the only thing standing between him and the forging of a new Thief's Dictatorship! We must work to remove the unworthy leader, and establish our Usoyan as Great Pakhan!
strings.YGR_redraw_the_provinces_desc: With our recent expansion into substantially more territory than we held previously, it is time to set up our provinces accordingly. With the current bureaucratic strain we suffer from, a proper and proportional redistribution of territory to our thieves will both bolster our popularity and reduce our burdens.
strings.YGR_dreams_of_centralization_desc: The potential to become a proper nation of thieves is there, right in front of us! All we have to do is set up our nation in a way that enforces the hierarchy we need to survive. A good way to start is to move towards government centralization; reduce local governance, restructure some bureaucracy, and, most importantly, get rid of the opposition.
strings.YGR_a_home_for_the_thief_desc: Our territory is meant for us; the thieves, the people, the Russians, the Eurasians. All of us make our home here, and it belongs to no one other than us. The Thief Territory can be, will be, must be the home of the thief-in-law.
strings.YGR_maintain_our_current_organization_de: In our current establishment lies the bedrock for the system Russia deserves; a society that benefits both our vory v zakone and the common man. Under this regime, the Russian people will be saved from the madness of authoritarians, communists, Nazis, liberals, monks, murderers, monarchists, and militarists. Under Jaba Ioseliani, Russia will be a real, good country.
strings.YGR_calls_for_a_thieves_dictatorship_des: The current establishment is not conducive to a functioning state; in this time of chaos, the only thing that will save Russia is a strong one, under the rule of a powerful leader. The vory v zakone must mobilize into a force of authority, ensuring the security of prosperity of all of Russia's peoples.
strings.YGR_of_the_criminal_by_the_criminal_for_: Of the Criminal, by the Criminal, for the Criminal

Russia no longer needs authoritarian figureheads to forge itself; its thieves can do a much better job than they ever could. Our system will easily prove itself to be the best alternative for Russia out of all the others.
strings.YGR_time_for_change_desc: For the sake of our government, we must center our focus on enforcing our power and building our people into a source of power, resources, and the protection of our statuses as vory v zakone. Any other path would surely spell death for our new nation.
strings.YGR_a_nation_of_our_own_desc: Regardless of how we end up running the place, we must ensure that people like us have a “place” at all. Whether by old ways or new, Russia will truly be a nation for us, whether the madmen, strongmen, pansies, and jackboot lickers of the world like it or not.
strings.YGR_prisoners_no_more_desc: With so much done so quickly, we must look back and remember how we got here. It was only through the ingenuity, bravery, and sacrifice of a few noble scoundrels that we were even able to be free, much less leaders of a nation. Because of them, the people of Russia will no longer be forced to wallow in poverty, be crushed under the jackboot, or starved under the hammer and sickle. No more will we be prisoners, and forever more shall we be free!
strings.YGR_the_economic_issue_desc: The West Siberian region is a land of great potential.  Factories left over from Bukharin's attempts at modernizing the old Union can be found in every city, vast forests cover the frigid countryside, and the earth here holds a trove of natural resources and oil, ready to be exploited for our benefit.  However, it is also a region that has been mismanaged and torn apart by war.  The Bolsheviks in Tyumen ruined the land and starved their people through their laughable Five Year Plan.  The Black League stockpiled guns without care for money, never thinking about profit once when all that mattered to them was their fanatical “Great Trial.”  Sverdlovsk's Junta was still tainted by Bolshevism, and so it too suffered from economic issues.  We, on the other hand, understand the power of profit.  Soon, we will build new factories, create new corporations, and dig deep into the earth until West Siberia has money flowing out of its ears.
strings.YGR_mafia_run_businesses_desc: Back in the days of Bukharin's Union, the New Economic Policy allowed for limited private ownership, a small gem of prosperity within the byzantine socialist system that ultimately proved worthless in the face of the German invaders.  However, for the Thieves, the NEP was our salvation, and many opportunistic businessmen came to become profitable associates of ours.  We should copy this model, and make sure that the Thieves, and our friends, will have the necessary capital and economic freedom to ensure prosperity on their own terms.
strings.YGR_raking_in_the_riches_desc: Siberia, though seen by many foreigners as a cold and foreboding place, unsuitable for human life, is in fact teeming with the most fabulous quantities of coal, precious metals, ores, and oil that one could imagine.  Sadly, the Bolshevik incompetence, rampant warlordism, and Luftwaffe terror bombings have heavily limited the potential of this region.  That ends now.  There are enough resources below our feet to ensure our prosperity forever.  All we need is to grab the pickaxes and get our hands dirty, and the Thieves have never shied away from some good old hard work.
strings.YGR_support_legitimate_businessmen_desc: Oftentimes in business, outsourcing can be cheaper than handling everything by yourself.  Keeping it all in the family might make things more certain and secure, but unless we all start growing a third arm, there's only so much we can juggle.  Outside the Thieves' circle, there are plenty of individuals with a talent for business that just might be willing to work with us and establish very profitable relationships. We should offer our support, and most importantly, our money, to these “businessmen,” no matter how illegal their sort of business might be.  After all, we are criminals, no?
strings.YGR_found_criminal_corporations_desc: Let's face it, the old mantra of “The Bigger, the Better' is almost always true.  When it comes to business and profits, doubly so.  We can only make so much money extorting mom n pop shops and stealing from people who are already going hungry from lack of money.  It's time we move on from mere criminal rackets.  By centralizing our operations and creating large conglomerates, we can exert a great deal of control over our holdings and most importantly, ensure rapid and highly lucrative economic growth and development.  Soon, our slice of Russia will outshine the rest.
strings.YGR_end_the_vestiges_of_bolshevism_desc: The Bolshevik revolution was by far, the greatest tragedy to befall the Russian people.  Though the Tsar was a reactionary fool who hobbled Russia and sent countless thousands to die in his useless wars, the Bolsheviks inflicted countless terrors upon their own people, and lost so much of our nation to the Germans, who even we despise as barbarians that destroyed our beloved homes.  Most importantly, they denied the Russian the right to profit, the one motivation that will always ensure victory.  We, on the other hand, understand business.  We understand money.  And we are the ones in power now, not the Bolshevik scum.
strings.YGR_distribute_mining_contracts_desc: You give some, you get some, that's how the world works.  If we want to ensure that the already existing mining industries here grow into a pure money machine, we'll need to reward those friends of the Bratva that have been so loyal to us since we first freed ourselves from the clutches of Vorkuta.  Stock certificates and mining contracts will be distributed at competitive prices to those that can afford them, and especially those that are our friends.  The Thieves do not steal from our friends.
strings.YGR_the_all_russian_oil_consortium_desc: Perhaps the most valuable resource available to us to exploit in our current situation is none other than oil, or as some would call it, black gold.  We have received many reports from our best scientific minds that we may have only scratched the surface of the rich oil reserves of Siberia.  With the proper funding, and most importantly, the proper management, we can pool our know-how and capital together and create a massive oil company that will pump out profit like a great big river of money.
strings.YGR_steal_every_resource_desc: Coal.  Iron.  Aluminum.  Gold.  Precious Metals.  Oil.  It's reading like some babushka's shopping list, except we're the ones doing the selling, and we're getting real fuckin' rich from it too.  Already, opportunistic businessmen from within our borders and from lands beyond even Russia have sought to buy all that we have to offer from our mines and oilfields, and we are more than happy to oblige them.  So long as we keep the mines running and the derricks pumping, we'll have a non stop flow of profit.  But why should we settle here?  We need to prospect for more resources.  We need to dig bigger and deeper and open more mines.  Unemployment will be a thing of the past for those that accept the rule of the Thieves.  The natural wealth of Western Siberia is ours to steal, and perhaps soon, much, much more.
strings.YGR_the_next_step_desc:
Our early economic ventures have so far been a resounding success.  Under the wise leadership of the Great Pakhan, the Thieves have turned this war-torn wasteland into a land of opportunity.  Already, the people are forgetting those idealistic promises from the Bolshevik false saviors and the vitriolic hate of Yazov's gang.  There are only those that we exploit, and those we offer the opportunity for exploitation.

 But what now?  We can't possibly stop here.  We have the foundations for a free market built, and the resources to do it, but we have to spend our capital somehow.  The answer, of course, relies on Russia's two great strengths: agriculture, and industry.  We shall invest in light and heavy industry alike, from shoe factories to tank plants, and take a delicious slice of the profits.  As for the farms dotting the countryside, the horrible collectivization policies will be reversed, or at least revised into something that is more...profitable to our needs.  Let's get back to work and we can pump in even more profits than we ever thought possible.
strings.YGR_getting_our_hands_in_the_dirt: Getting our Hands in the Dirt
strings.YGR_getting_our_hands_in_the_dirt_desc: Russia is a nation of peasants.  Though urbanization has been a trend since the late 19th century, the largest of Russia's cities, like Moscow and Petrograd, now lie largely in the hands of the German bastards, whom we cannot do anything about yet.  However, we can focus on undoing that horrific Bolshevik program of collectivization, which punished farmers just for being enterprising and successful at their jobs, with countless millions carted away to the Gulags as “kulak capitalists” while the rest were treated as cattle by the state.  We shall allow this no longer.  The farms too, must be opened up to the market, and the red plague shall infect the fields no longer.
strings.YGR_keeping_our_minds_bright_desc: Knowledge is power, and power is something that the Great Pakhan is always hungry for.  The German invasion threw our country into anarchy, and who suffered most of all?  The little boys and girls, who should have been growing up in school were now forced to beg on the streets just to survive, and left at the mercy of petty warlords.  Sure, we might be warlords too, but we're warlords with principles.  If the little ones are growing up illiterate and dumb, Russia will suffer compared to her international competition, and if we ever desire to become a world superpower, the next generation of Russians are going to have to be the best and brightest around.
strings.YGR_give_a_cut_to_the_farmers: Give a Cut to the Farmers
strings.YGR_give_a_cut_to_the_farmers_desc: Farming in West Siberia is no easy task.  The growing months are short, winter is long, and food is hard to come by for many people here.  Though the Thieves aren't exactly interested in charity, we can only tax people so much if they have nothing to us but starving masses.  Using what taxes we have collected already, and the profits coming in from our other ventures, we shall begin an ambitious program of farming subsidies to ensure that the peasants can afford modern farming equipment, proper homes, and fields full of grain.  The days of empty shelves shall be a thing of the past.
strings.YGR_price_controls_desc: Life in Russia is hard for almost everyone.  Peasants, workers, merchants, you name it, they're probably broke and hungry.  But why should we go out of our way to be their charity?  We're Thieves, damnit, it's in the name.  If we want to keep the people from all starving to death, perhaps we should make food more affordable so they have more money to give to us in taxes.  Usoyan has proposed we institute a program of price controls and rationing to ensure everyone has their fill and can work hard for our new capitalist class.  All it takes is a single stroke of a pen, and we can make starvation just a fading memory for those that accept our wise policies.
strings.YGR_rekulakisation_desc: One of the great tragedies of the Old Union was the great atrocities committed against those farmers that knew how to run their farms right.  Labeled as “kulaks,” their land was seized and collectivized and the farmers themselves were carted off to the camps for the crime of being good at their job.  This process, if Russia is to be a prosperous nation, must be reversed.  Those farmers that have the entrepreneurial spirit and a willingness to work with us for our mutual benefit will be handsomely rewarded with all the land, tools, training, and money they need to ensure that our agricultural sector runs efficiently and profitably.  Never again will those that have been forced to give up their livelihoods for those that have not, for poverty is the fault of the weak.
strings.YGR_consolidate_smaller_farms_desc: Collectivization was a horrific crime that saw family farms combined by the state, successful peasants carted off to the camps, and the rest forced to be nothing more than farmhands on their own land.  However, collectivization came with one advantage, and that was that the smallest farms that were inefficient subsistence plots became part of a larger and more powerful whole.  With Bolshevik incompetence a thing of the past, the guidance of the Thieves will see smaller farms absorbed into larger estates, under the control of those who are most loyal to us.
strings.YGR_your_taxes_for_development_desc: There are only two things that are certain in this world, death, and taxes.  Russia's already had a lot of death in these past decades, and let's face it, what people really want now is just the assurance that today won't be their last day on Earth.  As for us, what we want is more profits and a bigger budget so we can keep expanding our ventures, legal or otherwise.  So if the people don't want death, perhaps we can have a win-win deal and settle for some good old taxing every cent they have in exchange for their continued safety and security.  Some might call it racketeering or extortion, but we in the Bratva are fine with “just good business.”
strings.YGR_a_school_in_every_village_desc: Within the urban areas like Cheylabinsk, Surgut, or Tyumen, there are already existing school systems for the children.  Though the German bombings and our hostile takeover of the area has damaged it, our biggest priority has to be solving the fact that many kids in the rural villages can't even put 2 and 2 together!  Using our “taxes for development” scheme, we can ensure that those villages we so generously squeezed every cent out of can rest assured that at the very least, their kids will get to go to school every day while their mommies and daddies tend to the farms.  Furthermore, we can make sure that technical education becomes a reality for those students that don't want to pursue higher education, so they can become top-notch farmers or industrial workers.
strings.YGR_an_education_for_crime_desc: Education is good and all, but street smarts are a lot more important than book smarts.  What use is a bright mind if you have no clue how to fight and struggle and make yourself known?  The Thieves rely on bright young criminals that are ready to beat up and kill at a moment's notice and run a business the next.  Kids ought to be taught on how to survive in the real world, and instill a proper...enterprising spirit in their young minds rather than whatever Bolshevik bullshit they were getting stuffed in their brains before.
strings.YGR_an_university_in_every_city_desc: Teaching kids the ABCs and 123s is good and all, but there's a difference between the 3rd grade poetry recital and being a rocket scientist.  Once those kids graduate school, we're gonna need to make sure the brightest of them end up with the right tools to succeed in bringing us new technologies and that good old Russian spirit of innovation.  Per the order of the Great Pakhan, proper universities will be constructed in every single urban district in the Thief Territory, and admissions committees will be set up to ensure that the best and brightest, or the richest, for that matter, are able to become top notch scientists, doctors, engineers, mathematicians, and whatever else those nerds like to study.  What matters for us is that Russia can once again become a beacon of science and innovation, and innovation breeds profit.  Lots of it.
strings.YGR_knowledge_isnt_free_desc: As it turns out, running a state-of-the-art education system isn't gonna be cheap.  We're not doing this out of some benevolence for the masses, we're doing it because it's necessary for any functioning state to have proper education.  Unfortunately, it's also putting us in the red!  Many nations charge money, and quite a few large amounts of money, for students to attend privately run universities, especially when said universities are among the “elite schools” within their systems.  If some rich parents want to bribe their kids into university, who are we to say no?  We'll just ramp up those totally necessarily exorbitant admissions prices and keep the bribes coming.  As for those who can't afford it?  Too bad.  Maybe they can become criminals instead and leave those rich nerds to their own machinations.
strings.YGR_urbanize_our_holdings_desc: Washington, Tokyo, Germania, Rome.  When people think of the Great Powers of this world, the first thing that comes to mind is the sprawling centers of political and economic power they possess.  A proper power ought to have great cities, teeming with commerce and culture, a testament to the strength of their people and leadership.  The Thief Territory has a few large cities, but they are dwarfed by those of other nations in both population and financial power.  We will encourage investment and settlements in our industrial cities like Tyumen and Surgut through incentives like reduced taxes and offers of stimulus packages to prospective capitalists.  Furthermore, we will start to build new factories and mining towns, so urban settlements can start to grow naturally within our lands without constant government intervention.  Perhaps we'll even get a few brave tourists!
strings.YGR_let_the_money_flow_desc:
Well, who would have thought?  When you let such fine businessmen as ourselves run an entire country, we might be able to turn a ruble or two in profit.  Our banks are flowing with so much gold and cash, we can't even figure out what to do with it!  Our economy is being constantly reinvested with all the income we're making from local “development taxes” and foreign contracts with corporations from Philadelphia to Tokyo.  Our farms are running so efficiently you'd forget we're right smack in Siberia, and those cursed bread lines are a thing of the past, at least for those that accept who's on top.  

 As for us, can things even get better from here?  Our associates are building factory after factory, the once unemployed masses turning out everything from shirts to cars to fighter jets for our own use and for opportunistic entrepreneurs.  What do they do with all those weapons we're selling?  That's none of our business, so long as they keep paying us what we do.  Profit has become the word of the day, and even minor Pakhans are swimming in that sweet, sweet cash.  So long as we keep growing our ventures, the party will never end.  Here's a toast to many more profitable ventures to come!
strings.YGR_army_of_the_thieves_desc:
Though we might be shrewd in the fields of business, both legal and that of more...criminal natures, the army of the Thief Territory is not much more than a ragtag militia. Only through shrewd tactics and trickery was our ill-equipped force able to unify our little corner of Russia. However, we may not be so lucky in the future. Our prospective enemies to our west and east possess professional militaries and a burgeoning military industry. If we do not modernize our own forces into something that is worthy of being a true army, we will surely be crushed and our way of life may be lost forever. 

 	 The Great Pakhan will not let this injustice stand. Our enemies grow their forces by the day, and so shall we. New soldiers shall be found and trained, new officers commissioned, no matter the price, and we shall acquire modern tanks, planes, and weaponry to fuel our conquests by any means necessary. We Thieves are at our hearts, those men that refused to die to this cold and hateful world. Now we shall show it who its true masters are. Let none oppose us.
strings.YGR_disband_the_militias_desc: The first step in our modernization program must be the formal abolishment and disbanding of the many militias we have recruited in our earlier campaigns. Against similar forces, they were barely a match, but now that our enemies are no longer mere warlords, the bandits must professionalize into something resembling a real army. There can be no excuse for ill discipline, patchy equipment, and non-standard uniforms anymore.
strings.YGR_modernize_the_forces_desc: Though discipline and training remain a serious issue for our forces, it will matter little how good our individual warriors are trained if they do not have the arms and leadership to make them into real soldiers. Though in theory, our men should all be armed with Kalashnikov rifles, protected by T-55 tanks and BTR troop carriers, and have the skies above watched by jet fighters, the truth paints a much less flattering picture. Many of our rear echelon units still use Mosin-Nagant rifles from the War, and many lack ammunition even for those if they are lucky enough to have a weapon! Our armored units and air force are to put it mildly, nonexistent. We cannot expect to win a war if this sorry state of affairs continues any longer.
strings.YGR_expand_territorial_recruitment_desc: Our system of governance largely relies on local pakhans governing our territory for us. A Pakhan, within his borders, is responsible for the thieves below him and any associates that work with the Mafia. Furthermore, it is his right to offer \“protection,\” pass laws, levy taxes, and conscript troops for the national army under his command. Though this system is prone to corruption, given we are criminals, it also works. So long as the local pakhans keep paying their dues in taxes and troops to the Great Pakhan, we will not have to deal with any unfortunate shortages in recruitment targets when the time comes for war.
strings.YGR_national_conscription_desc: The Thief Territory is a largely anarchic place. The Law of the Thieves gives local pakhans virtually absolute power over their holdings. All we ask in return? Loyalty, and a lot of money. Unfortunately, some pakhans are giving us neither. These disloyal fools not only seriously threaten our financial and military situation, but as gangsters, they tend to get into very bloody turf wars with the forces of other pakhans, causing division within our ranks and terrorizing the local civilians we have put under our protection. We will tolerate this no further. All military recruitment will be done at a national level, with every oblast required to give a certain number of conscripts monthly. Any pakhans that do not comply will be punished severely.
strings.YGR_advanced_training_methods_desc:
Germany. Japan. America. The three great superpowers of the world are divided in ideology, holdings, and objectives, and threaten the world with a nuclear Sword of Damocles. But what do they have in common? 

 	 Professional armies, trained to fight and die at a moment's notice for Freedom, for Führer, or for the Emperor. 

 Our troops are not quite so fanatic, at least not in the ways we would want them to, and they are certainly not disciplined or trained to fight like soldiers in any sense of that word. Per the Great Pakhan's order, regional training camps will be set up around the country to train new recruits, indoctrinating them with the necessary discipline, skills, and physical and mental fitness to fight like real warriors. Furthermore, our current troops will be constantly retrained and drilled to stay in top shape, and we will send our officers for education from the best advisors money can buy on the tactics and strategy of modern warfare.
strings.YGR_teach_them_strength_desc: The best trait a soldier can have is physical fitness. Even if the enemy is better armed, and their soldiers better led, we will drill and train our men so that one of ours is worth a hundred of the enemy's. Harsh physical training regimens involving regular cardiovascular exercise and strength training will put our boys in tip-top shape, ready to march for miles and fight like demons straight from hell. We'll show them who's boss of Russia!
strings.YGR_teach_them_shrewdness_desc: What use is it to have the strength of a bear if you have the brain of a donkey? We don't need an army of illiterate, untrained rabble if we expect to have any stake at claiming all of Russia. Thankfully, not all hope is lost. The Thieves have plenty of experience in unconventional forms of warfare. All soldiers, NCOs, and line officers will receive appropriate training in guerilla warfare, ambushes, night attacks, and reconnaissance. Creative solutions and initiative will be encouraged, as opposed to the strictly hierarchical command structure of the old Union that crumpled against the Nazi advance. Our enemies will never know what hit them!
strings.YGR_form_the_spetsnaz_desc: In war, some missions are just too dangerous for the average soldier to handle, no matter how well-trained or experienced he is in battle. For tasks like espionage, sabotage, and raids behind enemy lines, our army will need a new class of warrior. Recruited from among the best soldiers we have in our ranks and the best mercenaries money can buy, these elite soldiers will be formed into a new unit -- the Voyska Spetsialnovo Naznacheniya, or Spetsnaz for short. Trained to fight anywhere, anytime, and any way, the Spetsnaz will pave our path to victory in the blood of our enemies.
strings.YGR_the_finest_artillery_desc: Napoleon Bonaparte once said that “God favors the side with the best artillery”. Napoleon eventually lost to none other than Mother Russia, but he still managed to win against all of Europe for nearly fifteen years. Since Napoleon's time, however, artillery has gotten just a little more advanced than smoothbore, muzzle loaded cannons. Some Soviet theorists believed that the use of mass artillery strikes combined with rapid shock assaults could have disorganized German forces pushing into Russia. Of course, Bukharin's incompetency meant they never got the chance to prove their hypothesis. Now, we will, and turn our enemies into a fine pink mist in the process.
strings.YGR_ready_for_war_desc: The Army of the Thieves has come a long way from a bandit clique formed of common criminals and hastily conscripted peasants. Gone are the days when we hid in fear of Blokhin's thugs, or cowered at the thought of facing the fanatics of Marshal Yazov! They are all dead, but we have risen from their ashes and feasted upon their demise. Whoever looks upon our steely ranks now will have no doubt it will be us to reclaim the mantle of Russia, and bring honor and glory to the Motherland whose soldiers once marched from Paris to Alaska!
strings.YGR_aid_from_general_batov_desc: General Batov was once an enemy to us, a leading commander in the 3rd Army to our south and widely reported to be Marshal Rokossovsky's successor. Though Sverdlovsk ultimately fell in our hands, Batov's forces were some of the few that didn't accept our bribes and fought to the bitter end. Since then, he has proven invaluable in organizing our new army. Though he has little love for the Thieves, if Batov wishes to serve Russia, then we will give him everything he needs to that end.
strings.YGR_tanks_of_our_own_desc: The last five decades of conflict, from the Great War to the Russian Anarchy, have shown us the necessity of superior armor in any serious conflict. Our connections in other Russian states have sent us back blueprints and reports of new tank forces being developed and deployed by our potential adversaries in the fight to unify Russia. This threat to the Thieves cannot stand. We will ensure extensive financial rewards for our military engineers to get modern tank designs into production, with the speed, armor, and armament to turn whatever tanks the enemy throws at us into scrap metal.
strings.YGR_stealing_the_skies_desc: Though having a strong land force is key to any military engagement, modern warfare also requires supremacy in the skies. Though we do currently possess an air force, it is not one much worth writing home about. Largely consisting of Great Patriotic War-era propeller planes and Soviet Il-2 bombers, these museum pieces have little use in today's battlefields. Recent developments in jet engines have proven fruitful. It is time we trade out our Messerschmidt fodder for new pilots and new planes, worthy of this supersonic age. The skies will be ours for the taking.
strings.YGR_investment_to_helicopters_desc: Supersonic fighters and bombers are certainly a great addition to our armed forces, but the modern age has brought with it a new kind of aircraft -- the helicopter. Though much slower than fixed wing aircraft, helicopters have many advantages. They can fly low to the ground, hover in place, are easier to operate, and most importantly, can give and take a lot of punishment. It would be keen to invest in not only transport helicopters, which can quickly transport supplies to the front and the wounded from danger, but attack helicopters as well. Capable of taking out both infantry and tanks alike with a variety of bombs, rockets, and machine guns, very little will be able to survive a barrage from our new toys.
strings.YGR_a_mechanized_army_desc: Though armored tactics can punch deep into enemy lines and cause a great deal of chaos and destruction, recent armored exercises have shown that our tanks are still very vulnerable to enemy infantry if unescorted by ground forces of our own. Though getting our footsoldiers mechanized will be a great logistical challenge, the fruits of our efforts will be more than worth it. Rather than marching long distances, our men will certainly enjoy resting their legs in the back of a truck, and elite mechanized forces transported by APCs and IFVs will be more than capable of supporting our tankers in battle.
strings.YGR_nothing_but_the_best_desc: At last, our investments into research and procurement of new equipment have proven profitable indeed. The Great Pakhan can rest easy knowing that the Thieves' Army is the finest in Russia. One of our troops is easily worth 10 of any pathetic conscript the enemy throws at us. They ride into battle in cutting edge tank designs to rival even the Leopard and Clark, easily cutting through the tin cans our rivals can barely afford to keep running. The skies scream with the sound of our fighters cutting through the air, while helicopters bring death from above. While we might not have the biggest army around, we can say with pride that we have nothing but the best in our ranks. To victory and profit, we march on!
strings.YGR_the_tyumen_military_accademy_desc: No army can fight and expect to win unless it is properly led. Though we are already putting effort into the training of our soldiers into a proper fighting force, they will be nothing but cannon fodder without officers trained in the modern concepts of war. In the city of Tyumen, former home of the Stalinists, Stalin and his lackeys had made quite the impressive military academy to train its new Red Army. Though it's since fallen into disrepair, we could easily reopen it and train a new generation of officers fit to lead our army to many glorious victories to come.
strings.YGR_studying_strategy_desc: The Thieves in Law are at their root, an organization of criminals. No criminal can even claim the title of Thief unless he has served multiple prison stints! However much tradition may be important to us, we will need to break from our roots in some ways if we wish to survive. The Circle, and the Thieves organization as a whole, must not be led by uneducated thugs who know only how to use their fists. Though it's great that our subjects fear us, our enemies will not fear a nation led by illiterate criminals. Those Thieves that can't even bother to learn how to read and write properly can easily have their territory “adjusted” to something more manageable for the feeble-minded.
strings.YGR_send_the_scientists_to_work_desc: Innovate, Innovate, Innovate! Innovate or die! Any good businessman knows this. Those that stay stuck in the past, sticking desperately to the outdated will ultimately be driven to extinction by those who forge the future. Though many decry us as exploiters of the common people, we also can appreciate the value of patronizing the sciences. We will make sure that those with education in the fields of science and engineering do not go unemployed and provide them with the funds they need to make their dreams reality. After all, their success is our profit, and if they happen to be working on something that can kill people? Then their success is our victory.
strings.YGR_theorize_new_industrial_methods_desc: Many centuries ago, a man in China named Sun Tzu wrote a book known as “The Art of War”. It's required reading in many military academies around the world, and most recently was added to the curriculum of our own military schools. War, however, is not only an art. It is a science. Like any science, war can be perfected. It can be methodical. We can learn from what doesn't work and explore further what does. Every aspect of our war machine must be experimented on and brought down to a science. Who said the Thieves were stupid men?
strings.YGR_adapting_to_survival_desc: Though we might march on into the future, and arm ourselves with the newest war machines, it will all be for nothing if we forget our origins. We were once mere bandits, those few that survived the terrible years under Blokhin's whip in the icy hell that was Vorkuta. We were all once prisoners -- all Thieves are by definition, or else he is not a real Thief. We fought and earned every scrap of food, every kopek, every day we were still alive in that terrible place. We fought for the right to survive, and for the right to rule. Now that we are the masters of this land, we must not grow complacent now. We must adapt constantly to the threats around us, or we will die.
strings.YGR_entering_the_global_theater_desc:
The Thief Territory is no longer just a warlord state. We are not mere bandits. The Thief Territory is a nation, and that is an indisputable fact. We have clearly defined borders, an army, and a stable government under the wise leadership of our Great Pakhan. 

 	Ioseliani has insisted that with our ambitions stretching across the Russian state, we must reach out to the world, especially the democracies of the OFN. By promising some nominal reforms, we could gain access to investments from the powerful American economy and advisers from their government and armed forces to aid in our modernization. 

 	Usoyan, however, has a different opinion. The Spider holds that we shouldn't put all our eggs in one basket, and instead catch as many new friends as we can in his web. After all, more investments means more profit, does it not?
strings.YGR_neutral_as_the_swiss_desc: The Russian bear has always been the subject of international intrigue. Some love us. Some fear us. And many have tried to conquer us, some successfully. Now that Russia has awoken from her sleep, the Americans and Japanese alike will try to woo us with promises of freedom and profits, and the Germans denounce us as Slavic dogs who will soon be conquered in totality once and for all. They will all be disappointed if their aim is to make us their puppet. If, on the other hand, they wish to approach us with honest intentions of trade and business, who are we to reject them?
strings.YGR_a_meeting_in_madrid_desc: The Iberian Union is a chimera born from the chaos of the Second World War. Mostly aligned with the victorious Italy before the war, the Twin Caudillos suffered greatly from the Atlantropa disaster. Though both our nations may suffer from poverty and instability, we also have much to gain from mutual cooperation. A mutual hatred of the Germans, a mutual love of capitalism, and most importantly, a mutual respect for strong leadership. General Franco has seemed quite approachable to offers from the Great Pakhan. Perhaps a meeting with the Caudillo himself in Madrid might prove a fruitful venture?
strings.YGR_contacts_with_cosa_nostra_desc: La Cosa Nostra, \“Our Thing\” in English, is based in Sicily and is one of the oldest and most powerful organized crime organizations in the world. Spreading with the Italian diaspora from Sicily to Chicago, names like Al Capone or Lucky Luciano come to mind in the eyes of many Amerikantsi when they think of the Mafia. What do we think of them? Natural business partners. Surely, it takes a criminal to know a criminal, and though the Cosa Nostra accepts only Italians into its family, they have yet to shy away from a good deal. Let's make them an offer they can't refuse.
strings.YGR_shady_dealings_in_switzerland_desc:
Ahh, the Swiss. What could we want with those cowardly, neutralist, peace-loving bastards? 

 Record scratch. Freeze frame. 

 \“What do you mean they're armed to the teeth and have more money than they know what to do with? Get me to Zürich, now!\” 

 Though little Switzerland might not seem like it has much to offer at first, the Great Pakhan has been recently informed by more approachable allies of Usoyan that the Swiss banking sector will trade with just about anyone, even the Russian states that they ostensibly embargo at Germany's behest! Perhaps some of our \“Taxes for Development\” could easily be transferred for safekeeping in Swiss banks, or invested in Swiss businesses. The Swiss capitalists might also be interested in gaining access to our extensive natural resources, and their usually neutral government could certainly have an interest in gaining a future bulwark against Pakt dominance of Europe. We shouldn't delay any further. Let's get packing!
strings.YGR_boats_to_britanny_desc: The French have little interest in paying heed to Germany's commands, especially after the Franco-Burgundian war resulted in them losing territory to the Reich's nuclear-enthusiast problem child. What they do have an interest in is profit. French weapons are of some of the highest quality in the world, shipped en masse to war zones around the world. France's black market has even infiltrated its tendrils into our own country! Though we've tried to crack down on them in the past due to its negative influences, perhaps we could strike a deal on more equal terms. If the frogs can get safe passage into Russia, they will reward us handsomely.
strings.YGR_diplomacy_by_gold_desc: The Germans prefer diplomacy by the tip of a bayonet, subjecting the \“subhuman races\” of Europe and Africa to countless tortures while claiming that the Pakt is for the good of all Europe. The Japanese promise liberation to the Asian race while enslaving them for every last drop of profit. The Americans promise freedom and democracy, but will seemingly go to very undemocratic measures to bring nations into their sphere, willing or otherwise. Though within the halls of power, their leaders deride us as nothing but greedy bandits, we are at least honest about our intentions. We don't ask foreign nations for their servitude, nor for them to change their ways of life. We offer them goods, and we ask for nothing but payment in return. Perhaps what the world needs for peace is a healthy dose of capitalism, and we are more than happy to provide it.
strings.YGR_the_great_pakhans_friends_in_america: The Great Pakhan's Friends in America

What does Aslan make the Great Pakhan out to be, a fool? If we were to follow the Spider's advice, we would give Usoyan a free hand to take over the reins of state while Jaba is too busy making dealings with irrelevant leaders. Instead, Ioseliani has proposed that we make use of his connections with certain business figures in America to gain a line to their government. The OFN will be more than happy to support a resurgent Russia in their fight against the Nazi menace, while our respect for the ideals of capitalism and the right to wealth will certainly sit well with their capitalist class, ready to invest in our rapidly liberalizing and expanding national economy.
strings.YGR_promises_of_freedom_desc: Though so far, the American government has responded quite amicably to our requests for humanitarian aid and economic development, their politicians, ever insistent on spreading their ideas of \“freedom\”, \“liberalism\”, and \“democracy\” have placed a caveat for any further aid to our state. They have claimed that our leadership is unnecessarily authoritarian and corrupt, given that we have established order within West Siberia, and that the Thief Territory must take efforts to democratize and give non-Mafia members input in the government. Furthermore, they have outrageously demanded that we, an organization composed of criminals, take \“serious efforts to reduce crime and corruption\” within our country! Though there are no plans to oblige these demands in any serious manner, organizing some local elections and putting a limit on our more...brutal side is a necessary evil if we wish to be recognized as a legitimate state by the Free World.
strings.YGR_invite_american_corporations_desc: Sure, humanitarian aid is great, but what the Great Pakhan really wanted from America wasn't the honeyed words of their politicians, nor the thoughts and prayers of the American people. Those mean nothing to him. Ford? General Motors? General Electric? Valero? Those do. What Washington can't provide us, Wall Street certainly can. With the aid of our new business partners in America, American consumers will soon drive their cars on Russian fuel, purchase Russian made consumer goods, and get new electronics made with Russian rare metals. In return, their foreign investment will gain our citizens new opportunities for employment, meaning a large boon in taxable income for our state as a bonus to the extensive profits we will already rake in from all these new trade deals.
strings.YGR_invite_the_CIA_to_the_war_room: Invite the CIA to the War Room
strings.YGR_invite_the_CIA_to_the_war_room_desc: Officially, America's support has been purely of a humanitarian nature, providing our people with food, infrastructure, and healthcare after so many years of Bolshevik mismangaement and German terror bombings. The CIA, America's feared spy agency, has less need to obey political convention. Recently, certain agents have made contact with senior military members within the Circle, offering tacit support in providing modern weapons and training for our officers and men. Though the presence of foreign agents comes with a security risk, we can assume that the Americans have a vested interest in strengthening our armed forces, as a united Russia would put Germany into a panic not seen since the German Civil War. Unfortunately, we can also assume that the same support is going to our potential enemies. Best not to look a gift horse in the mouth, especially one that can kill you in over seven hundred ways, and that's just with his bare hands.
strings.YGR_relations_with_malaya_desc: As a result of a brutal war for independence against the Japanese occupiers, a new Malaysia emerged. First and foremost, it is a country free from colonialism that is beginning to open up to the world, offering promising investment initiatives. In exchange for financing the construction of their shipyards, which will produce merchant convoys, they offer limited access to their mineral resources. This information is constantly on the mind of our Pahan, who seems to be seriously considering sending Russian corporations to extract rubber in the region!
strings.YGR_a_profitable_partnership_desc: What can we say about our new friends in America? The Great Pakhan's scheme has paid handsomely now as American corporations generously invest into Thief-owned businesses, and we're getting all the richer for it. Through our political contacts with America, we've even started opening up trade with other OFN nations. Notably, we've started to make new partnerships with Canadian and Australian companies, netting us new partners in the Pacific ocean. The Army greatly appreciates the covert aid of the CIA, and are even in the process of setting up a spy agency of our own. Even the people have much to be happy about. Though they might be paying up to their neck in taxes, those with the right connections are now enjoying all sorts of western goodies, from cars to coffee. Let's hope this lucrative relationship comes to benefit both our states for many more years to come.
strings.YGR_all_the_pakhans_men_desc: An arduous journey West lies behind us, and we have PREVAILED! The West is now in our hands, and we may do with it as we please... or rather, how the Great Pakhan wishes. But besides that, for all our triumph there is still a lot to be done, the land integrated, the men satiated, the ambitions expanded.
strings.YGR_reward_the_loyal_desc: Loyalty is a great virtue... one we must continuously reward. Those that have acted the most in our interests will receive their dues, but so will those that welcomed our arrival in the West. If the local populace sees that supporting us comes with greater benefits, maybe less will resist.
strings.YGR_integrating_our_new_lands_desc: With the recent subjugation of our western rivals new lands fell unser our control: we must stabilize our new possessions and pacify any resistance.
strings.YGR_once_a_bandit_desc: The arrival to the West could also mean some meaningful reform to our system. After all, we cannot be simple criminals forever now, can we? We should begin some reforms...
strings.YGR_always_a_bandit_desc: Reforms from simple criminals, to EXQUISITE ONES, of course! The Lace, the Circle, the Vor v Zakone system, now we have a whole half of Russia to spread these institutions to! No time to waste!
